changes: notes: removed the unchecked claim that the date corresponds exactly to Monday 25 October 1613; the weekday has not been verified
notes: added that the era conflicts with the catalogue's ŚS 1670 (= 1748 CE) and explained why VS is preferred
notes: added that 'ābhyaṃtaranāgara-' refers to the Abhyantara Nāgara brahmin community and that the name that followed is lost

notes: The quoted colophon stops at 'ābhyaṃtaranāgara-' (Abhyantara Nāgara, a group of Nāgara brahmins of Vṛddhanagara/Vadnagar, Gujarat). The scribe's or owner's name that followed is not quoted, so no person can be extracted. Hanumat, named as the author in the title formula, is a mythical figure and is not included. Era: the bare 'saṃvat' together with the Gujarati setting (Vadnagar, Nāgara, 'vadya') points to Vikrama Saṃvat. VS 1670 Kārttika vadi 7 falls about October–November 1613 CE. This conflicts with the catalogue's 'ŚS 1670', which would be 1748 CE. The Monday (some) weekday has not been checked against either era.
